name: reweigh
description: Consult Claude Code from Codex through resumable sessions that do not edit your project, pinned to a commit when needed, run in the background for long reviews, and read Claude Code's recent sessions in the same repository.

interface.shortDescription: Consult Claude Code without driving its app
interface.longDescription: Ask Claude Code a scoped question, follow up in the same conversation, pin it to a commit, run long reviews in the background, and read Claude Code's recent sessions in this repository. Claude only reads, unless one of your own agent types it starts creates a worktree (REWEIGH_SUBAGENTS=0 prevents it); nothing is written to an existing session.
